contributor_notes: Documentary about Hollywood's depiction of trans people. All named interviewees are described as prominent trans figures speaking about their own experiences, hence self-identified-public sourcing. The film critiques the 'deceptive trans' trope in other media (e.g. Ace Ventura, Tootsie) rather than employing it, so rep_tropes is left empty. Sam Feder's identity is not stated in the source text and should be verified before publication.
